plot_summary:
Theo Appleseed is the protagonist. On Monday Morning, July 29, 2024 at 7:30 am, Theo Appleseed were involved. Theo has a booked train trip to Chicago. Leaving tomorrow at 15:07 pm from the Central Station.
 generate calendar_events for the plot. In the calender event added a note for saving 1h travel time from office. Also he received the ticket number and booking reference number through messages for the train ticket.
user_goal: You want the note that you left on your train trip event read out to know what time you need to leave the office at.

reasoning: Right so, the user wants to know about the note on their event today. I can see one event matching in their calendar titled 'Train Trip to Chicago' scheduled for 30th July 2024 at 15:07. The note attached says, 'Train trip to Chicago. Remember to leave 1 hour early from office to reach the station on time.' I can read this out to the user.
query: Read out the note on my event later today.
